justification: Inspected byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/bytecode/member/Invokedynamic.java and byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/bytecode/member/InvokedynamicTest.java. The class is small (87 lines), has only four state fields, one constructor, and one behavioral method (`apply`); it performs a single cohesive responsibility: converting JavaConstant arguments and emitting one `visitInvokeDynamicInsn` call while computing stack size. The test covers that single scenario, and there is no evidence of multiple responsibilities, high method count, or separable abstractions that would indicate insufficient modularization.
